higher_education_registry_county_coverag.method: Unique city-to-county lookup in the school registries

project_matching_method: Unique exact normalized name and city; otherwise a unique exact normalized name across locations; for a shortened name, a unique exact address with the beneficiary name as a full-word prefix of the registry name. An exact registry name with the project city removed from the end of the beneficiary name is also accepted when unique in that city; the same shortened name can support an exact address match. Nine additional school records with exact city and address matches were explicitly curated. Additionally, 45 primary-school records were linked to registry records confirmed by the user; 3 Italian or bilingual Rovinj primary-school records remain unmatched.
regional_summary_scope: Projects matched to a school, kindergarten, or higher-education registry record with a county. A unique name match can link across different beneficiary and registry place values; the regional assignment uses the registry county. Higher-education counties are inferred only from a unique school-registry city lookup. This is not a complete regional distribution of all Erasmus+ projects.
